scope: Chat misc — list/delete sessions + history compression

feature_test_scripts.scripts_summary: Auth required (401); user isolation (B's sessions excluded for A); ordered by updated_at DESC; LIMIT 100; empty list valid; data shape {data:[...], total}
Auth required; cross-user 404; non-existent UUID 404; happy path 204 No Content; cascade delete via ON DELETE CASCADE removes messages; idempotent (404 on re-delete, never 500)

_history_token_budget reads CHAT_HISTORY_TOKEN_BUDGET env (min 500, default 8000); _approx_tokens does len/4 estimate; under budget → returns input unchanged; over budget → drops up to second user message preserving first; assistant tool_use blocks stay glued to their assistant message (no half-turn drops); empty history short-circuits
